arcs.title: The Duck Bandit Returns
arcs.summary: Day 3: A third duck has appeared, completing a set of three hats (original undocumented style, wide-brim amber felt, flat wool cap) all using a six-point crown construction. Pemwick has traced the pattern to a redacted 1987 Craft Guild appendix entry — 'Six-Crown Travelling Hat, maker known, location variable, leaves no trace, always returns' — with the maker's name removed in excellent handwriting. The Guild has received a request for the original files and is 'considering' it. The Guild archivist's demeanour suggests she knows more than she is saying. Priority Amber. Day 4 should bring a breakthrough: either the Guild archivist provides a partial clue (initials, a location, a phrase), or someone in the broader Jeep community — perhaps another recipient of well-hatted ducks — comes forward and recognises the style from a previous encounter years ago, giving the Bandit a shape, a history, and perhaps a motive that points warmly toward Christine and Steve specifically.
